summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: UnderlineBar (src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py) now yields one Text object with clickable_ranges as trailing @click spans, and the zero-width early path skips them. Opacity (src/textual/renderables/opacity.py) merges the blended color into the existing style so meta is preserved. New src/textual/widgets/tabs.py contains Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs. Layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Also added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, and tests in tests/test_tabs.py, tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, and tests/renderables/test_opacity.py. Choices: Tabs uses can_focus=True; letter search applies only to single-character keys; zero-width labels get no layout edge; duplicate names map the full-list bar position through the name to the displayed tab. Caveats: test expectations are unverified because nothing was run; some docstring prose lines in tabs.py and underline_bar.py exceed 88 columns.
